title: Ptolemy Equality Converse for Unit-Circle Points

problemStatement.formal: For four distinct unit-circle points, prove that Ptolemy equality implies counterclockwise or clockwise cyclic order, and package this as a biconditional with the forward CCW equality theorem.
problemStatement.plain: Complete the unit-circle converse direction for Ptolemy equality: equality of the chord-length expression forces the four points into one of the two cyclic orders.
whyMatters: The converse turns Ptolemy equality from a one-way theorem into a cyclic-order characterization
The proof exercises complex half-angle factorization and sign analysis for points on the unit circle

insights: unit_star_eq_inv: Complex.mul_conj gives z * starRingEnd ℂ z = ↑(normSq z), combined with normSq=1 and norm_cast gives z * conj(z) = 1, then mul_left_cancel₀
ptolemy_ratio_pos_of_ccw proof architecture: hfact → h2isin → hha (half-angle helpers) + hE (phase cancellation) + hcalc (scalar identity) + hLHS/hRHS calc blocks
For CCW order θ₁<θ₂<θ₃<θ₄<θ₁+2π: s12=sin((θ₂-θ₁)/2)>0, s34=sin((θ₄-θ₃)/2)>0, s23=sin((θ₂-θ₃)/2)<0, s14=sin((θ₁-θ₄)/2)<0; ratio = (-s23)(-s14)/(s12·s34) > 0
Converse direction strategy: ptolemy_equality_implies_proportional gives t > 0 → write zk=exp(iθk), substitute half-angle factorization, cancel phases → t = sine ratio
sin_half_sign_iff: sin((θ-φ)/2) > 0 ↔ φ < θ for θ,φ ∈ (-π,π] — bridges algebraic sign to geometric order
8-case sign analysis via mul_pos_iff/mul_neg_iff: 4 cases from (num>0,den>0) + 4 cases from (num<0,den<0), each giving CCW or CW witnesses
Shifted witnesses (θ±2π) with period lemmas (hexp_add2pi, hexp_sub2pi via Complex.exp_add) handle cases where natural angle ordering needs adjustment
CW backward direction: apply ptolemy_ratio_pos_of_ccw and ptolemy_equality_of_proportional to reversed argument order (z1,z4,z3,z2), then use norm_sub_rev + linarith
